paite: Remaliah tapa Pekah kum sawm-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Jotham tapa Ahaz alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz / (2 Kro 28.1-27)
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Ahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal hi. Apu David bang in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih ahih sam kei hi.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh his God’s eyes, like David his father.

paite: Israel kumpipate tot lampi atawn sam a, ahi, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih bang un atapa mei ah alutsuaksak hi.
english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel.

paite: Mun sangte leh mualte tung ah leh sing hing chih nuai ah kithoih in gimlim ahal hi.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah, Jerusalem dou ding in akuantou ua; Ahaz ava um ua, himahleh azou thei kei uhi.
english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

paite: Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin in Elath khua Siria gam ding in ala nawn a, Elath a pan Judate adelhkhia a; huchi in Siriate'n Elath khua ava luah ua, tuni tan in ateng lai uh.
english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kiang ah, "Na sikha leh na tapa ka hi kei a hia; kei hong dou dia hong kuan, Siria kumpipa khut a pan leh Israel kumpipa khut a pan hon hunkhe dih ve," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

paite: Ahaziah in TOUPA' inn a dangka leh dangka-eng om peuhmah leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmte ala a, Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thilpiak ding in akhak hi.
english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in Yahweh’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n athugen ana pom a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n Damaskas khua ava dou a, ala a, Kir gam ah sal in huai a mite api a, Rezin athat hi.
english: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz bel Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser houpih ding in Damaskas ah ahoh a, Damaskas ah maitam ava mu a, huchi in kumpipa Ahaz in huai maitam lim leh akibawldan bang geih etton ding in siampu Urijah kiang ah akhak hi.
english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

paite: Siampu Urijah in maitam abawl a; kumpipa Ahaziah in Damaskas a pan akhak bang geih in siampu Urijah in Damaskas a pan a Ahaz ahong pai nawn in ana bawl khin vekta hi.
english: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

paite: Damaskas a pan kumpipa ahong tun in maitam amu a; kumpipa'n maitam anaih a, atung ah thillatte alan hi.
english: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

paite: Maitam ah ahalmang thillat hal in tangbuang thillat alan a, dawn thillat asung a, alemna thillatte sisan atheh hi.
english: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

paite: TOUPA ma a dal maitam ala a, maitam leh TOUPA' inn kikal a, inn mazawn a pan alasuan a, amaitam mallam pang ah akoih hi.
english: The bronze altar, which was before Yahweh, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and Yahweh’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in, maitam lianpi tung ah zinglam halmang thillat, nitaklam tangbuang thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, i gam ua mipi tengteng halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh hal in lan inla; atung ah halmang thillat sisan tengteng leh kithoihna sisan tengteng theh in; dal maitam bel kei thudotna ding ahi, chi in siampu Urijah thu apia hi.
english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Urijah in kumpipa Ahaz thupiak bangbang in ahihta hi.
english: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in tunna kuakte a-atkhia a, kisilna bel akoihkhia a; atunna dal bawngtal a pan lakhia in suanglep tung ah atung hi.
english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

paite: Sabbath ni a dia atung nei lampi abawl uleh inn polam a kumpipa lutna TOUPA' inn a pan Siria kumpipa a ding in akheng hi.
english: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Ahaz api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Hezekiah alalta hi.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
